current: After the last page StoryReaderView stops narration and goes straight to StoryEndingLeaf: Ragi waving, 'Masal bitti!', reading counts and a 400 ms celebration, the same in every mode.
suggested: In bedtime mode only: let the last story page stand alone as a quiet moment (no auto-advance, narration ends softly), and make the ending leaf calm: no celebration animation and no reading counts on that screen; keep today's ending for adventure and learning.

recommendation.rationale: Two required voices heard and both support (reader owns the target, privacy-safety pass with conditions). 5 of 5 bedtime books end quieter than their average; none of 21 books has a celebration after the story. A UX target cannot be an experiment, and the change is small, reversible and display-only (StoryEndingLeaf, gate story.mode == bedtime or clock). Evidence LOW, so adopt as guidance for the bedtime ending, not as a rule for other modes.
